title: Concept of Short Reply (Inversion)
theory:
 Positive reply (We use 'So')

 Subject + Verb + ........ + Connector + so + helping Verb + Subject

 Positive Inversion

 .g. I am happy, and so is she.
  Negative reply (We use 'Neither/Nor')
 Subject + Verb + ........ + Connector + Neither/Nor + helping Verb + Subject

 Negative Inversion

 .g. I don't like coffee, and neither does my brother.
 Note
 We can use "either" in case of negative reply, but there is no inversion.

 .g. I don't like coffee, and my brother doesn't either.
